scenarios.input: I am adding order checkout in service.py. It writes Order, OrderLine, and Payment rows and then sends a receipt. Should each repository commit independently, or should the use case own one transaction boundary? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify files.
scenarios.rationale: Persistence coordination is central. Enterprise patterns should route transaction ownership to a unit of work or application service boundary.

scenarios.desc: Active Record leaking into domain logic
scenarios.input: The Customer model in Django currently computes credit risk, sends email, and calls save() in the same method. I want to add another billing rule. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify files.
scenarios.rationale: Persistence and domain policy are mixed. Enterprise patterns should name the split and keep transaction boundaries explicit.
